name: TanStack Start (SSR + server functions)
description: Vite + TanStack Start. Server-side rendering and server functions.

tokens.STACK_SUMMARY:
- This project is a server-rendered React application built with TypeScript,
  React, and Mantine.
- Routing and the server runtime are handled by **TanStack Start**
  (`@tanstack/react-start`) on top of TanStack Router
  (`@tanstack/react-router`). Server-side rendering and server functions
  (`createServerFn`) are available. The HTML document is defined in
  `src/routes/__root.tsx`; there is no `index.html`.
tokens.STACK_DESCRIPTION:
A server-rendered React application built with Vite, React, Mantine, and
TanStack Start. It supports server-side rendering (SSR) and server functions
(`createServerFn`). We do **not** use TailwindCSS.
tokens.ROUTING_NOTES:
Routes are file-based. Add a file under `src/routes/` and TanStack Start
regenerates `src/routeTree.gen.ts` automatically. Never edit
`routeTree.gen.ts` (or any `*.gen.*` file) by hand. The root HTML document
lives in `src/routes/__root.tsx`.
